thread:
Sam (Acme): Hey team, onboarding issue — our app returned 403 when calling /v1/generate. Console shows no API key under our project (cust-4321). Can you check?
Maria (support): Sorry about that, Sam. Can you confirm the org ID and the email you used to sign up? Also any error body you got?
Sam (Acme): Org: acme-inc (org-998). Signup email: sam@acme.com. Error: 403 {"message":"API key not found or not scoped to this project"}. We have a support ticket #24462.
ProvisionerBot: New provision claim created: claim_id=clm-77a2, service=service-account-provisioner, target_project=temp-provision-789, created_at=2024-11-28T14:02:12Z
Maria (support): Noted. Filing this to infra. @Raj can you take a look? Looks like the key might have been created in a temporary project instead of cust-4321.
Raj (eng-infra): On it. Can you paste the customer-facing key id from the error (if any) or the provisioning logs? Also, did the customer sign up via OIDC or invite flow?
Sam (Acme): No key id in error. They signed up with OIDC via acme okta. I can share the provisioning webhook payload from our side: 
```
{
  "claim_id": "clm-77a2",
  "org_id": "org-998",
  "preferred_project": "cust-4321",
  "allocated_project": "temp-provision-789",
  "key_id": "ak_61b3...",
  "status": "BOUND"
}
```
Maria (support): copied. Looks like allocated_project is temp-provision-789 — that explains why they don't see it in their console.
Raj (eng-infra): Thanks. Quick triage: check provisioner logs around clm-77a2. I suspect a race where the provisioner picked a fallback project during a transient quota lock. @Elliot any recent changes to the provisioner?
Elliot (eng): We rolled a small change to retry/fallback behavior last week (deploy-bot: roll/provisioner v2.14.3) at 2024-11-28T13:58:03Z. It's supposed to only use fallback for internal tests, but looks like a logic gap.
Raj (eng-infra): Ok — probable path. Two remediation options: 1) Rebind the existing key to cust-4321 (fast, minimal downtime) or 2) Revoke the key and reprovision a fresh key in the correct project (cleaner audit trail). Which do we want?
Jenna (csm): Customer wants to go live today. They'll prefer fast rebind if no security concerns. Please note audit will show the rebind. I'll confirm with Sam.
Sam (Acme): Rebind please. We just need the key visible in our project.
Kai (oncall): Raj, please ensure the rebind operation logs who performed it and add an alert if similar allocated_project!=preferred_project occurs more than 3 times in an hour.
Raj (eng-infra): Agreed. I'll do a rebind and then schedule a post-mortem on the fallback logic. Plan: run migration script to update key ownership and push console sync. Running this now.
Raj (eng-infra): Running command: 
```
# reprovision helper (dry-run first)
python infra/tools/rebind_key.py --key-id ak_61b3... --from-project temp-provision-789 --to-project cust-4321 --dry-run
```
Raj (eng-infra): Dry-run shows: key ak_61b3... owner -> cust-4321, console sync pending. Proceeding with live run.
Raj (eng-infra): Live run complete. DB change: UPDATE api_keys SET project_id='cust-4321', bound_at='2024-11-28T14:21:45Z', bound_by='raj' WHERE key_id='ak_61b3...'; Console sync job enqueued (job_id=job-9932).
ProvisionerBot: Console sync completed for key ak_61b3... -> visible_in_project=cust-4321 (job-9932)
Sam (Acme): I can see the key now in the console and calls to /v1/generate succeed. Thanks! :tada:
Jenna (csm): Thanks team — I'll update the customer-facing ticket #24462 and note the workaround and ETA for the permanent fix.
Raj (eng-infra): Permanent fix: revert the test-only fallback path and add stricter guardrails + an alert. ETA for patch: 48 hours. I'll open an internal follow-up and link to this thread.
Maria (support): Closing loop with customer and creating postmortem stub. Follow-up action items: @Elliot pick a rollback or safe-flag for v2.14.3, @Raj implement detection alert, @Kai run HV test on provisioner.
Maria (support): Sam, please reopen if anything else pops up. Apologies again for the friction.
Sam (Acme): All good, appreciate the quick turnaround.
